x: Brazier were 2nd and 3rd in the 100 yards and P. Cornelius was the only other runner in the 220.
Graham Worrell (24.2) and Pat Cornelius (24.8) were 3rd and 4th in the furlong, whilst Dave Mitchell (2:6.2) and F. Paget (2:12.0) took 5th and 7th places in the 880 yds.

This let in Graham Worrall and Pat (Nanny-Goat) Cornelius and Mike Smithers to take the medals. The 'quarter' developed into a two horse race between Worrall and Pete Pepe, whose form over the hurdles has of late been so encouraging.

Our main point-scorers in this match were Gerry Leroy, Bill Kerr, John Thresher and Pat Cornelius. Although beaten in the 220 yards by Marsh of Hercules, Gerry ran a fine 'quarter' to edge out Sunstan (S.L.H.) in 50.9 to show that he is still a force to be reckoned with over one lap.
A proposal made by Dave Martin Shepherd and seconded by Pat Cornelius that Arthur Penstone be elected to Life Membership was carried unanimously.

There were 7 starters in the 120 yards sprint and Pat Cornelius (off five yards) steamed home in a brisk 12.7. Later he made full use of his 5ft. 6" allowance in the shot to beat all but one of the 8 competitors with 33'0".
